integrity: The formula has a direct finite-field linear-algebra proof and separately replayable exhaustive checks; publication and independent validation are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts labeled incidence-algebra elements and Jordan multiplicities, not similarity or conjugacy classes. Does not cover arbitrary posets or odd characteristic; wider parabolic square-zero formula coverage remains a bibliographic risk.
scientific_scope: Involutive elements with g squared equal to one in complete three-antichain-level incidence algebras over finite fields of characteristic two, with exact Jordan-block rank counts.
title: Characteristic-two involution Jordan spectra for three-level incidence algebras
